Hint.Value: EOS login successful. Your Epic account is connected and working.
EOS identity token copied successfully. Authentication is working.
EOS operation completed successfully. Everything is working normally.
EOS backend connection failed. Check your internet connection. EOS servers may be temporarily down.
EOS request failed. Usually temporary. Check firewall/antivirus not blocking the game.
EOS cannot connect to Epic servers. Check internet connection. Offline play is not affected.
EOS HTTP request returned an error. Server may be temporarily unavailable. Usually not critical.
SSL connection error to EOS servers. Usually a temporary network issue. Can be ignored if not persistent.
EOS is reading data from cloud storage. Normal synchronization. Can be ignored.
EOS is cleaning up temporary files. Normal maintenance. Can be ignored.
EOS could not clean up a temporary file. It will be cleaned later. Not critical.
EOS sanction check passed. No active sanctions on your account. Normal.
EOS detected active sanctions on your account. Check your Epic Games account status.
EOS Voice chat subsystem. Related to in-game voice communication.
EOS Peer-to-Peer networking. Related to multiplayer connectivity.
EOS Anti-Cheat subsystem. Related to EAC integration.
EOS (Epic Online Services) message. Usually informational. Check detailed logs for connectivity troubleshooting.
Discord integration message. Usually informational.
Discord Rich Presence initialized successfully.
Discord operation failed. Check Discord client is running and connected.
Discord Rich Presence audio/network warning. Normal Discord SDK behavior. Can be safely ignored.
Game is recalculating terrain cells. Normal during world generation and block placement. Can be ignored unless causing lag.
No terrain-aligned block registered at position. Normal when placing blocks. Can be ignored.
UI binding warning. A controller action has no keyboard binding. Add bindings in game settings if needed.
UI element missing in XUi XML. The referenced control doesn't exist in the window group.
UI targeting warning. Usually harmless. Related to interaction prompts on blocks/entities.
Twitch Drops check failed (404). Normal if you don't have active Twitch Drops. Can be ignored.
